expected.title: Island Grid Begins Tidal Battery Trial
expected.author: Mira Sol
expected.text: Engineers connected a tidal generator to a neighborhood battery before sunrise. The twelve-week trial will publish open performance notes for local schools.
expected.description: A coastal cooperative is testing stored tidal power.

expected.title: Rooftop Seed Library Opens
expected.author: Noah Imani
expected.text: Volunteers catalogued sixty varieties in weatherproof drawers. Borrowers return seeds from their strongest plants after harvest.
expected.description: Neighbors can borrow seeds adapted to small balconies.

expected.title: Night Ferry Adds Quiet Cabin
expected.author: Elena Park
expected.text: The redesigned cabin uses warm floor lighting and fabric wall panels. Announcements are delivered through seat displays except during emergencies.
expected.description: A low-light cabin gives overnight passengers a calmer crossing.

expected.title: Canal Sensors Map Summer Heat
expected.author: Priya Mensah
expected.text: Students anchored compact sensors beside bridges and public gardens. The readings will help planners choose locations for shade and fountains.
expected.description: Floating sensors record block-level water temperatures.

expected.title: Repair Cafe Publishes Tool Map
expected.author: Samira Ko, Luis Okafor
expected.text: The map lists shared drills, sewing machines, and diagnostic meters by neighborhood. Maintainers can post availability without exposing a home address.
expected.description: A community directory helps residents find rarely used tools.

expected.title: Library Courtyard Reopens
expected.text: New benches surround the restored rain garden beside the reading room. The courtyard remains open until sunset and requires no reservation.

expected.title: 社區天台花園迎來第一批蜜蜂 🐝
expected.author: 陳美玲
expected.text: 義工在清晨安置了三個本地蜂箱。 訪客可用粵語、English 或日本語閱讀安全指引。
expected.description: 多語言導賞介紹城市授粉計劃。

expected.name: Pocket Weather Dial
expected.description: A pocket-sized mechanical dial for comparing air pressure trends.

expected.name: Foldaway Plant Stand
expected.description: An oiled-oak stand that folds flat between seasons.

expected.name: Modular Tea Tray
expected.description: Interlocking trays keep cups steady on narrow tables.

expected.name: Solar Thread Lantern
expected.description: A soft lantern woven around a replaceable solar core.

expected.name: Recycled Felt Pinboard
expected.description: A quiet pinboard pressed from recovered textile fibers.
